narrative_purpose: The chapter's representative plate for the landing book-map: a great winged Pandoran flier riding the air against the floating mountains, posed so its impossible scale - a body too large for any Earth sky - reads at a glance as the puzzle the chapter solves.
subject: A mountain banshee in full soaring flight, wings spread wide and taut, seen against a backdrop of the floating Hallelujah Mountains. The wings are great leathery membranes stiffened by a fan of semi-rigid vanes along the trailing edge, faint cyan bioluminescent veins threading through them; a tiny Na'vi rider sits low on its back, small enough that the wingspan dwarfs them and the true size lands.
scene: High open air among drifting island-mountains, deep hazy distance falling away below, wisps of cloud catching the light.
camera: A sweeping three-quarter view from slightly above and ahead, the flier filling the frame, the floating peaks soft behind.
light: Cool daylight diffused through haze, bioluminescent glow tracing the wing veins and the hollow bone, deep indigo shadow beneath the wings, one scarce warm amber accent at the eye.
palette: Void-indigo and teal sky-haze, cyan glow in the wing membranes, cool bone-grey on the frame, a single restrained amber accent.
style: Painterly naturalist plate, hand-painted texture, confident focal hierarchy.
detail_level: Crisp on the wing membrane, vanes, and rider; the floating peaks softer; background dissolving into haze.
composition: The flier strong across the upper-centre with wings spread full-width, floating peaks lower and behind, generous dark sky for text, 3:2 landscape.
consistency_notes: Cool Pandora palette, bioluminescent key from within the wing. Same dark glowing mood as the established chapter covers.
negative_prompt: no text, no lettering, no numbers, no logos, no diagram labels, no arrows, no photographic or 3D-render look, no lens flares, no cartoon or anime style
